---
title: "Anagine Report"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
params:
  meta_json: "{}"
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

meta <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$meta_json)

df <- meta$fetchedData
if (is.null(df) || length(df) == 0) {
  df <- data.frame()
} else {
  df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
```

## Run info
```{r}
print(knitr::kable(data.frame(
  generated_at = meta$generated_at,
  kernel = meta$kernel,
  fetchedCount = meta$fetchedCount
)))
```

## Filters
```{r, results='asis'}
filters <- meta$filters
`%||%` <- function(a,b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

if (is.null(filters) || length(filters) == 0) {
  cat("No filters applied.\n")
} else {
  to_vals <- function(x){
    if (is.list(x) && !is.null(x$selectedValues)) {
      paste(x$selectedValues, collapse = ", ")
    } else if (is.list(x) && (!is.null(x$lowerBound) || !is.null(x$upperBound))) {
      paste0("[", x$lowerBound %||% "-inf", ", ", x$upperBound %||% "+inf", "]")
    } else if (is.character(x) || is.numeric(x) || is.logical(x)) {
      paste(x, collapse = ", ")
    } else {
      as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(x, auto_unbox = TRUE))
    }
  }

  df_filters <- data.frame(
    field = names(filters),
    value = vapply(filters, to_vals, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print(knitr::kable(df_filters, align = "ll"))

  cat("\n\n<details><summary>Raw filters (JSON)</summary>\n\n```json\n",
      jsonlite::toJSON(filters, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE),
      "\n```\n\n</details>\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Basic Summary
```{r, results='asis'}
if (nrow(df) == 0) {
  cat("No fetched data. Please call /anagine/fetch first.\n")
} else {
  summary_cols <- intersect(c("aki_status","study_site"), names(df))
  if (length(summary_cols) == 0) {
    cat("No summary columns found in fetched data.\n")
  } else {
    for (col in summary_cols) {
      cat("\n\n### ", col, "\n\n", sep = "")
      tab <- sort(table(df[[col]], useNA = "ifany"), decreasing = TRUE)
      out <- data.frame(
        value = names(tab),
        count = as.integer(tab),
        percent = round(100 * as.integer(tab) / sum(tab), 1),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      print(knitr::kable(out))
    }
  }
}
```

## Numeric ranges
```{r, results='asis'}
if (nrow(df) > 0) {
  num_cols <- intersect(c("year_of_birth","days_to_death"), names(df))
  for (col in num_cols) {
    cat("\n\n### ", col, "\n\n", sep = "")
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]]))
    x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    if (length(x) == 0) {
      cat("No valid numeric values.\n")
    } else {
      s <- summary(x)
      out <- data.frame(stat = names(s), value = as.numeric(s), row.names = NULL)
      print(knitr::kable(out))
    }
  }
}
```

## Plot: year_of_birth vs days_to_death
```{r}
if (nrow(df) > 0 && all(c("year_of_birth","days_to_death") %in% names(df))) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      year_of_birth = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year_of_birth)),
      days_to_death = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(days_to_death))
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(year_of_birth), is.finite(days_to_death))

  if (nrow(df2) > 1) {
    p <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = year_of_birth, y = days_to_death)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
      labs(x="year_of_birth", y="days_to_death",
          title="year_of_birth vs days_to_death")
    print(p)
  } else {
    cat("Not enough valid points for plot.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Missing required fields.\n")
}
```
